turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
s
$16.30

Hi, soak both the top and ceramic cone in water for at least 15 minutes, assemble them underwater to knock out air bubbles, then insert the cone into pre-moistened soil. Put the tube at the bottom of a full water container, and keep the water level at or below the green cap for the best flow. For larger plants, use two or three cones, and remember it will only draw water up to 12 inches. This is the right setup if you want a simple, low-maintenance houseplant watering option.
